title: Appealing an Infraction

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
In the past year, you've gained 28 infractions.
Out of the 28 infractions, 23 are for chat misconduct.
Just a month ago, you got a ban for Excessive Infractions.
Then, you seemed to rack up 3 more and judging off your in-game behavior, you didn't behave well enough in the first place to stay on our servers.

Regardless, the actions you've chosen to take aren't in the slightest good, and you've had out of all those infractions, say, 27 warnings. You didn't take any of them seriously, and it led to a ban. You also even got to the point of a permanent ban a year ago as well, and the behavior remains the same. You were punished for excessive infractions as well by Riskings, and carrying out this punishment into a ban wasn't harsh or anything, but simply enforcing the rules.

Once you've cleared up your act, I think you'll have more credibility and clearance for another appeal if you happen to make one. 

Also, refer to the previous senior responses:
https://avicus.net/forums/0d3d78e60?reply=201782
https://avicus.net/forums/314bb01b0?reply=203681

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
The only way to "get rid" of an infraction is to appeal it, but to wipe the actual infraction itself away, only an administrator can do that and it's only in special cases. Generally, we only want bans to be appealed though and not warns or kicks.

As for appealing punishments from a year ago, the situation and assessment of the punishment itself isn't really clear enough to warrant appealing for something so long ago where it wouldn't be easy to know what happened.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
It's (probably) better off to not excessively use language in chat like you've been doing, no matter the scenario. It's necessary to know that excessive swearing isn't tolerated, and looking at your infraction history for an appeal, it isn't in good light anyway since you've cut it close quite a few times.

Generally, the "b" word you're referring to is used as an insult towards someone, in it's context it's still an insult.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

The punishment issued by ParaSpider is valid, and you will not be appealed. Despite your most recent appeal you continued to break the same rules. We can't keep dishing out appeals for players who continuously abuse others. You have had numerous chances and a permanent ban was issued because of this. Next time consider abiding by the rules before getting into similar situations.

Regards,
Mango_
